rules.proposal: Start with natural, cut-and-polished Sri Lankan ruby and blue sapphire; exclude specialty effects and ambiguous identification.
cagsDecisions: Confirm initial varieties and identity evidence.

rules.proposal: Use a red-dominant ruby category; route borderline ruby/pink-sapphire descriptions for expert review.
cagsDecisions: Choose masterstones, observation conditions and boundary vocabulary.

rules.proposal: Assess saturation, tone, brightness and face-up distribution together; do not treat stronger saturation as always better.
cagsDecisions: Calibrate tone and saturation anchors; decide interactions and exceptions.

rules.proposal: Do not extend blue-sapphire preferences to every colour; require separate review for additional hue groups.
cagsDecisions: Review pink, yellow, green, purple and colourless criteria separately.

rules.proposal: Evaluate visibility and transparency impact with inclusion type, position and durability concerns; some silk can improve appearance.
cagsDecisions: Specify data fields and expert-referral triggers. Current engine lacks type/location scoring.

rules.proposal: Assess optical appearance, proportions and finish; geometric ratios alone should not determine cut quality.
cagsDecisions: Choose observation protocol and assess windowing/extinction without double counting.

rules.proposal: Report depth/width x 100, or depth/mean(length,width) x 100 for round stones, as transparent project calculations.
cagsDecisions: Validate denominator and shape convention. Do not infer ideal thresholds from this formula.

rules.proposal: Record weight and use it in comparable selection and price-per-carat calculations; avoid presenting size as quality.
cagsDecisions: Consider removing carat from the quality-weighted total; calibrate weight bands separately.

rules.proposal: Keep heated, unheated and unresolved treatment separate; unsupported treatments and uncertain evidence require referral.
cagsDecisions: Define required reports, stable-colour evidence and treatment mapping.

rules.proposal: Store origin evidence independently; do not award quality points solely from a geographic name.
cagsDecisions: Define acceptable evidence and verification procedure.

rules.proposal: Distinguish B2B quotes, wholesale guide ranges, retail asks and completed sales; never silently convert their market basis.
cagsDecisions: Select target Sri Lankan trade channel; confirm currency, dates, taxes, fees and reuse permission.

rules.proposal: Match variety, origin, hue, treatment and shape first; then constrain weight and quality distance.
cagsDecisions: Choose tolerances, source independence, age limits and minimum evidence.

rules.proposal: Use an auditable median of eligible price-per-carat values times subject weight; apply no extra origin or treatment premium initially.
cagsDecisions: Validate this estimator against expert cases and observed quotations.

rules.proposal: Keep quality adjustment factors at 1.0 until a paired dataset supports a calibrated adjustment model.
cagsDecisions: Determine whether score differences can justify monetary changes.

rules.proposal: An allowance around an estimate is a project parameter, not a measured confidence interval.
cagsDecisions: Calibrate range coverage on held-out expert cases or withhold a price range.

rules.proposal: Expose missing observations, evidence basis, sources and limitations. Trade labels and source grades must not become laboratory findings.
cagsDecisions: Approve report wording and who can sign off domain rules.
